A love letter to analog

Less perfect.
More alive.

Film asks you to pay attention. To wait for the light, trust your eye, and embrace the unexpected. We think that’s a pretty lovely way to see the world.

Golden Hour is a fictional studio concept for anyone who loves the magic of making something tangible.
